task: FV2-018 — Flutter frameless desktop window chrome and branded title bar
summary: Kept the signed-in macOS Debug app open throughout. Confirmed the Flutter drag region receives pointer-down and used DevTools hot reload for source updates. The desktop UI driver did not deliver a move event to Flutter's pan recognizer, so this session cannot independently verify native window movement. Windows native acceptance remains open.

checks.name: Focused desktop title-bar widget tests
checks.observation: Covers Windows controls/actions, text-only brand, macOS native-control inset, recognized mouse-pan start dispatch, and mobile platforms without desktop chrome.

checks.name: macOS native title-bar drag runtime
checks.observation: On the running BOOHTACORD Debug window, a DevTools read-only query showed `windowManager.getPosition() == Offset(1000,238)` before and after the attempted drag. Temporary diagnostic logging confirmed pointer-down reaches the drag region, but no pan-update event was emitted by the desktop UI driver; the driver therefore did not provide evidence that a real mouse drag was delivered. Temporary diagnostics were removed, the standard `onPanStart` path was restored, and the app was hot reloaded without restart. The app remained signed in on Text; no message, close/minimize action, microphone, or stream was activated, and no Keychain prompt appeared.

checks.name: macOS Debug build
checks.observation: Built build/macos/Build/Products/Debug/BOOHTACORD.app. Build completed without launching or restarting the app.
